title.pinyin: Yǔ Yè Lièchē Shang de Mòshēngrén
title.en: The Stranger on the Night Train

summary.cn: 在一列从上海开往北京的深夜卧铺列车上，疲惫不堪的建筑师偶遇了一位神秘的长者，展开了一场关于理想、都市压力与释怀的深刻交谈。
summary.en: On a midnight sleeper train from Shanghai to Beijing, an exhausted architect meets a mysterious older traveler, sparking a profound conversation on ambition, urban anxiety, and letting go.

partTitle.cn: 第一幕：深夜的站台与车厢
partTitle.en: Act I: Midnight Platform & The Carriage

sentences.cn: 雨水敲打着上海虹桥站的玻璃顶棚，发出沉闷而连绵的声响。
sentences.pinyin: Yǔshuǐ qiāodǎ zhe Shànghǎi Hóngqiáo zhàn de bōli dǐngpéng, fāchū chénmèn ér liánmián de shēngxiǎng.
sentences.en: Rain tapped against the glass roof of Shanghai Hongqiao Station, making a dull, continuous sound.

sentences.cn: 三十二岁的建筑师林舟提着公文包，步履匆匆地登上了开往北京的Z282次深夜卧铺列车。
sentences.pinyin: Sānshí’èr suì de jiànzhùshī Lín Zhōu tí zhe gōngwénbāo, bùlǚ cōngcōng de dēngshàng le kāiwǎng Běijīng de Z282 cì shēnyè wòpù lièchē.
sentences.en: Thirty-two-year-old architect Lin Zhou hurried onto the Z282 midnight sleeper train to Beijing, briefcase in hand.

sentences.cn: 为了完成那座商贸综合体的设计竞标，他已经在工作室里连续熬了三个通宵，整个人疲惫不堪。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile wánchéng nà zuò shāngmào zōnghétǐ de shèjì jìngbiāo, tā yǐjīng zài gōngzuòshì lǐ liánxù áo le sān gè tōngxiāo, zhěng gè rén píbèi bùkān.
sentences.en: To finish the design bid for that commercial complex, he had pulled three consecutive all-nighters in the studio, leaving him completely exhausted.

partTitle.cn: 第二幕：走廊里的深夜偶遇
partTitle.en: Act II: Conversation in the Corridor

sentences.cn: 车轮在铁轨上规律地颠簸着，车厢里的灯光早已调至微弱的夜间模式。
sentences.pinyin: Chēlún zài tiěguǐ shang guīlǜ de diānbǒ zhe, chēxiāng lǐ de dēngguāng zǎoyǐ tiáozhì wēiruò de yèjiān móshì.
sentences.en: The wheels jolted rhythmically on the rails, and the carriage lights had long been dimmed to night mode.

sentences.cn: 林舟毫无睡意，他独自来到车厢连接处的折叠窗前，望着窗外无边无际的漆黑原野。
sentences.pinyin: Lín Zhōu háowú shuìyì, tā dúzì láidào chēxiāng liánjiēchù de zhédié chuāng qián, wàng zhe chuāngwài wúbiān-wújì de qīhēi yuányě.
sentences.en: Lin Zhou felt no drowsiness; he went alone to the folding window by the gangway, gazing into the boundless, pitch-black wilderness outside.

sentences.cn: 身后忽然响起温和的声音：“年轻人，深夜不眠，往往不是因为身体不累，而是脑子里的思绪停不下来吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Shēnhòu hūrán xiǎngqǐ wēnhé de shēngyīn: “Niánqīngrén, shēnyè bùmián, wǎngwǎng bú shì yīnwèi shēntǐ bú lèi, ér shì nǎozǐ lǐ de sīxù tíng bu xiàlai ba.”
sentences.en: A gentle voice suddenly spoke behind him: “Young man, sleepless in the dead of night—it is rarely because the body isn't tired, but because the mind cannot stop churning.”

partTitle.cn: 第三幕：三十年前未寄出的信
partTitle.en: Act III: The Unsent Letter and Thirty Years

sentences.cn: 说话的是一位戴着金丝眼镜的老先生，手里拿着一本封面褪色的皮质笔记本。
sentences.pinyin: Shuōhuà de shì yí wèi dài zhe jīnsī yǎnjìng de lǎo xiānsheng, shǒulǐ ná zhe yì běn fēngmiàn tuìsè de pízhì bǐjìběn.
sentences.en: The speaker was an elderly gentleman wearing wire-rimmed glasses, holding a leather notebook with a faded cover.

sentences.cn: 老者从笔记本中抽出一封泛黄的信件，叹道：“三十年前，我也曾为了所谓的远大前程，日夜兼程地奔波在各大城市之间。”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎozhě cóng bǐjìběn zhōng chōuchū yì fēng fànhuáng de xìnjiàn, tàn dào: “Sānshí nián qián, wǒ yě céng wèile suǒwèi de yuǎndà qiánchéng, rìyè-jiānchéng de bēnbō zài gèdà chéngshì zhījiān.”
sentences.en: The elder pulled a yellowed letter from the notebook and sighed: “Thirty years ago, I too rushed night and day between cities for the sake of a so-called grand career.”

sentences.cn: “那时我总以为只要赢得更多项目，幸福就会如期而至。可当我拥有了一切，才发现最珍贵的人和岁月，早就在不知不觉中被自己弄丢了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Nà shí wǒ zǒng yǐwéi zhǐyào yíngdé gèng duō xiàngmù, xìngfú jiù huì rúqī’érzhì. Kě dāng wǒ yōngyǒu le yíqiè, cái fāxiàn zuì zhēnguì de rén hé suìyuè, zǎojiù zài bùzhī-bùjué zhōng bèi zìjǐ nòng diū le.”
sentences.en: “Back then I thought as long as I won more projects, happiness would arrive on schedule. But when I had everything, I realized the most precious people and moments had been lost without me even realizing.”

partTitle.cn: 第四幕：晨曦破晓与内心的释怀
partTitle.en: Act IV: Morning Light & Letting Go

sentences.cn: 老人的话语如同一股清泉，在林舟被功名利禄填满的心湖里激起了阵阵涟漪。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎorén de huàyǔ rútóng yì gǔ qīngquán, zài Lín Zhōu bèi gōngmíng-lìlù tiánmǎn de xīnhú lǐ jīqǐ le zhènzhèn liányī.
sentences.en: The elder's words were like a clear spring, stirring ripples in Lin Zhou’s heart, which had been choked by worldly pursuits.

sentences.cn: 天际渐渐泛起了微白，一轮温润的晨阳冲破了厚重的云层，金光洒满原野。
sentences.pinyin: Tiānjì jiànjiàn fànqǐ le wēibái, yì lún wēnrùn de chényáng chōngpò le hòuzhòng de yúncéng, jīnguāng sǎmǎn yuányě.
sentences.en: The horizon brightened with dawn, and a warm morning sun broke through the heavy clouds, scattering golden light across the plains.

sentences.cn: 当广播播报列车即将驶入北京南站时，林舟心中那些纠缠已久的焦虑，终于奇迹般地释怀了。
sentences.pinyin: Dāng guǎngbō bōbào lièchē jíjiāng shǐrù Běijīng Nán Zhàn shí, Lín Zhōu xīnzhōng nàxiē jiūchán yǐjiǔ de jiāolǜ, zhōngyú qíjì-bān de shìhuái le.
sentences.en: When the announcer declared the train was approaching Beijing South Station, the anxieties that had entangled Lin Zhou for so long finally, miraculously, dissolved.

exampleSentence.cn: 为了完成设计竞标，他整个人疲惫不堪。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Wèile wánchéng shèjì jìngbiāo, tā zhěng gè rén píbèi bùkān.
exampleSentence.en: To complete the design bid, he was utterly exhausted.

exampleSentence.cn: 车轮在铁轨上规律地颠簸着。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Chēlún zài tiěguǐ shang guīlǜ de diānbǒ zhe.
exampleSentence.en: The wheels jolted rhythmically along the train tracks.

definitions: to let go of an inner burden

exampleSentence.cn: 经过一番长谈，他心中纠缠已久的焦虑终于释怀了。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Jīngguò yì fān chángtán, tā xīnzhōng jiūchán yǐjiǔ de jiāolǜ zhōngyú shìhuái le.
exampleSentence.en: After a long conversation, the anxieties that had troubled his mind for so long were finally released.

exampleSentence.cn: 最珍贵的人和岁月，早就在不知不觉中被自己弄丢了。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Zuì zhēnguì de rén hé suìyuè, zǎojiù zài bùzhī-bùjué zhōng bèi zìjǐ nòng diū le.
exampleSentence.en: The most precious people and moments had been lost without him even realizing.

grammarNotes.explanation: Used to refute an assumed reason and reveal the true underlying factor (Often not because X, but rather because Y).
grammarNotes.exampleFromStory: 深夜不眠，往往不是因为身体不累，而是脑子里的思绪停不下来。
additionalExamples: 事情的失败往往不是因为能力不足，而是因为缺乏坚持。
他的沉默往往不是冷漠，而是在静静思考解决的办法。

grammarNotes.explanation: Expresses that meeting condition X is sufficient to guarantee result Y (As long as... then...).
grammarNotes.exampleFromStory: 只要赢得更多项目，幸福就会如期而至。
additionalExamples: 只要保持阅读的习惯，你的词汇量就一定会突飞猛进。
只要心怀希望，任何逆境都能安然渡过。

quiz.question: 林舟为什么要在深夜乘坐开往北京的卧铺列车？
options: 回故乡探望多年未见的亲人
为了完成商贸综合体的设计竞标而熬夜奔波
去北京度假散心以减轻疲惫
寻找三十年前的一位老朋友
quiz.explanation: 文章开篇交代：林舟为了完成商贸综合体的设计竞标，熬了三个通宵后提着公文包登上深夜卧铺列车。

quiz.question: 车厢里遇到的神秘长者认为人最容易犯下的错误是什么？
options: 为了追求物质和前程，在不知不觉中失去了最珍贵的亲情与时光
乘车时不遵守夜间安静规则
做建筑设计时缺乏创新灵感
quiz.explanation: 老者感叹年轻时日夜兼程奔波，虽然拥有了一切，却把最珍贵的人和岁月在不知不觉中弄丢了。

quiz.question: “疲惫不堪”中的“不堪”在汉语中的含义最接近哪一项？
quiz.explanation: “堪”表示经受、承受。“不堪”在这里表示疲倦到了极点、无法再承受的程度。
